info.title: Users
info.x-hubspot-api-use-case: Sync HubSpot user working hours with an external workforce management tool.
info.x-hubspot-introduction: Use this API to fetch information about users in the account, along with updating their working hours, timezone, additional phone number, and job title properties.

get.description: Read a page of users. Control what is returned via the `properties` query param.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored. Usage of this parameter will reduce the maximum number of objects that can be read by a single request.

post.description: Create a user with the given properties and return a copy of the object, including the ID. Documentation and examples for creating standard users is provided.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

post.summary: Archive a batch of users by ID
post.description: Archive multiple users by their IDs in a single request. This operation moves the specified users to the recycling bin, effectively deactivating them from active use.
Create multiple users in a single request by providing a batch of user properties and associations. This endpoint returns the created users along with their IDs.

post.summary: Read a batch of users by internal ID, or unique property values
post.description: Retrieve records by record ID or include the `idProperty` parameter to retrieve records by a custom unique value property.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

post.summary: Update a batch of users by internal ID, or unique property values
post.description: Update multiple user records in a single request by specifying their internal IDs or unique property values. This operation allows for batch processing of user data, ensuring efficient updates across multiple user profiles.

post.summary: Create or update a batch of users by unique property values
post.description: Create or update records identified by a unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query param. `idProperty` query param refers to a property whose values are unique for the object.

Permanently delete a contact and all associated content to comply with GDPR regulations. You can use the optional 'idProperty' set to 'email' to identify the contact by email address. If the email address is not found, it will be added to a blocklist to prevent future use.

Merge two CRM objects of the same type in your HubSpot account. This operation combines the properties and associations of the two specified objects into a single object, identified by the primary object ID.

post.summary: Search for users based on specified criteria.
post.description: Execute a search for users using defined filters, properties, and sorting options. The request must include a search query and can return up to 200 results per request.

get.description: Read an Object identified by `{userId}`. `{userId}` refers to the internal object ID by default, or optionally any unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query param.  Control what is returned via the `properties` query param.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

parameters.name: idProperty
parameters.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

delete.description: Move an Object identified by `{userId}` to the recycling bin.

patch.description: Perform a partial update of an Object identified by `{userId}`or optionally a unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query param. `{userId}` refers to the internal object ID by default, and the `idProperty` query param refers to a property whose values are unique for the object. Provided property values will be overwritten. Read-only and non-existent properties will result in an error. Properties values can be cleared by passing an empty string.

parameters.name: idProperty
parameters.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type

get.description: List all associations of a specified object by its type. This endpoint allows you to retrieve associations between different object types, with a limit of 500 associations per call. It is useful for understanding relationships between objects in your CRM.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

put.description: Create the default association type between two specified object types in the CRM. This endpoint allows you to establish a generic link between two objects using their types and IDs, facilitating data organization and relationship management within your HubSpot account.

Set association labels between two records in the CRM. This endpoint allows you to define the relationship between two specified objects by setting labels. It is useful for organizing and managing associations between different CRM records.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource
